checks.label: The average rate of change over an interval is the ratio of the amount of change in the function to the corresponding change in x: on every chord screen, for every pair of points P and Q it can show, the working reads (f(Q) − f(P)) ÷ (Q − P) in the y unit per x unit, and so does the drawing at its end and after a drag
Determines the gradient of a chord: on every chord screen the chord is drawn as a straight line from P to Q, and its gradient on the drawing, read back through the axes, is the slope in the working

On the straight line f(x) = 4x every chord gives 4 m per s, and the boat that started 10 m out gives 4 m per s from 1 s to 5 s (30 − 14 = 16 m over 4 s, where 30 ÷ 5 would give 6); on f(x) = x² the boat covers 1, 3, 5 and 7 m in its first four seconds, so its chords differ: 1 m per s from 0 s to 1 s, 3 from 1 s to 2 s, 7 from 3 s to 4 s and 6 from 2 s to 4 s, while from 0 s to 4 s both graphs give 4 m per s
The tank's rule gives 200 L at 0 min, 128 L at 2 min, 50 L at 5 min, 32 L at 6 min and 0 L at 10 min, so its chords give −30, −24 and −10 L per min, and every chord on its falling graph gives a minus
The example readings give 66 − 30 = 36 °C over 40 − 10 = 30 min, 1.2 °C per min, and 12 − 6 = 6 V over 4 s, 1.5 V per s, as the working under each table's graph says

Every puzzle offers three different answers and accepts only the right one; each wrong answer is the slip it stands for, worked from the same points: 70 m and 19 m against 30 m; 6 m per s and 0.25 s per m against 4 m per s; 10 m and 4 m per s against 6 m per s; +24 L per min and −96 L against −24 L per min; 0.67 s per V and 2 V per s against 1.5 V per s; and 0 and +10 L per min against −10 L per min

Before an answer no puzzle shows its answer: the working ends in a question mark, the triangle's sides read only Δx and Δy, and nothing is red; a right answer ends the working in it with nothing red, and every wrong answer shows its slip in red
Dragging keeps each point on a whole number inside the axes, with P always left of Q
Every demonstration has finished arriving within 4.5 s of its screen opening, none starting before the 0.35 s screen fade ends; every answer's motion, right or wrong, within 1.3 s

warnings: SVG labels "f(x) in litres" and "Δx = 5 min" are only 1 px apart on one row, so they read as one: leave at least 4 px between them, or label only what differs (at step = step 7, and 1 more setting) [at 340 px wide]
SVG labels "P (5 min, 50 L)" and "Δy" are touching on one row, so they read as one: leave at least 4 px between them, or label only what differs (at step = step 12, and 1 more setting)
